baseline_all_authentic.notes: Predicts 'authentic' for everyone; its accuracy is the share of authentic accounts.

transformer.input_view: post text (whitespace tokens, vocabulary from train)
transformer.notes: Trained from scratch (no pretrained weights). Account score = mean of 6 post probabilities.

gcn.input_view: 12 standardised profile stats as node features + undirected interaction graph

gat.input_view: 12 standardised profile stats as node features + undirected interaction graph

graphsage.input_view: 12 standardised profile stats as node features + undirected interaction graph

rgcn.input_view: 12 standardised profile stats as node features + undirected interaction graph
rgcn.notes: Transductive; train labels only. R-GCN uses a single relation type.

autoencoder_dense.notes: Trained without labels on all train accounts; score = reconstruction MSE.

autoencoder_lstm.notes: Trained without labels on all train accounts; score = reconstruction MSE.

multimodal_fusion.input_view: text embedding (frozen transformer) + 12 profile stats + interaction graph
multimodal_fusion.notes: Text encoder is frozen from section 7. Simplified stand-in for BIC.

one_class_svm.notes: Fitted without labels. nu=0.3 approximates the inauthentic share.

word2vec_logreg.input_view: post text -> mean word2vec vector per account

doc2vec_logreg.input_view: post text -> doc2vec vector per account (val/test inferred)

node2vec_logreg.input_view: interaction graph -> random-walk embedding per account

deepwalk_logreg.input_view: interaction graph -> random-walk embedding per account

label_spreading.input_view: interaction graph + a few known labels
label_spreading.notes: Graph-only. Score is a normalised propagated label mass, not a calibrated probability.

belief_propagation.input_view: interaction graph + a few known labels
belief_propagation.notes: SybilBelief-style loopy BP on a pairwise MRF; written from scratch. Belief is not calibrated.
